findings.claim: The prior session cookie is minted from a hand-written literal payload that duplicates what the oidcAuthPayloadDtoBuilder() already produces (same auth_method, same faker.string.numeric({ exclude: ['0'] }) for sub), instead of using the builder; the sibling unit spec in the same PR uses the builder, so tests should use it here too for consistency.

The PR title 'fix: Session duration step up' is a capitalised, non-imperative noun-phrase description, and since the merge strategy is squash-merge, this title becomes the permanent commit subject on main.
